title: skills(data): tell the builder to resolve security-rollup-source-unreadable by masking the parent summary on a set that may not read the child
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed (a row of epic #33595's milestone table, added by eval#1). Maintainer, 2026-11-15 ~11:22Z, verbatim on eval#1's decision card: 「改为搭建侧处理」. This is the authoring half of that ruling. Its scoring half is the scenario-runner card filed beside it.

## Mechanism

`os build` warns `security-rollup-source-unreadable` when a permission set can read a parent's roll-up (`summaryOperations`) field but cannot read the child object, the aggregated child field, or a field the roll-up's `filter` tests (`packages/lint/src/validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts`; `os explain security-rollup-source-unreadable`). The warning never fails the build. The authoring skill (`skills/objectstack-data`, e.g. `rules/relationships.md` / `rules/field-types.md` on roll-ups) does not tell the builder to resolve it. So builders finish with it standing: eval#1 found it in the build transcript of all 15 live `project_with_tasks` builds on main `3be13473` (2026-11-15).

## Why it matters

The set that may not see the child still reads an aggregate of it through the parent, so data the business means to hide leaks as a count or sum. The fix is one line in the permission set, and a builder that knows the warning makes it.

## Done when

- The skill's roll-up guidance tells the builder to resolve a `security-rollup-source-unreadable` warning before finishing. When the set may not see the child, mask the parent summary on that set (`fields["<parent>.<summary>"]: { readable: false }`). When it should see the child, grant the read. It never leaves the warning standing.
- The guidance carries one worked example in the skill's own dialect, checked against the lint rule (the masked set raises no warning).
- Skill edits follow the skills lane's own gates (teaching-card ratchets, evals) as AGENTS.md sets them.

## Reader

The `domain:skills` lane seat, through `pm:queue`. It is filed beside the epic seat's `domain:devx` scoring card; the two do not share files.

Dedup: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue security-rollup-source-unreadable` → 40 hits; none open beyond #33595 and two PM seat posts; no skills card on it.
